text:
sam: We're scheduled to cut deploy at 11:30 PT (release/v1.14.0). Who's on the deploy and who owns rollback if canary fails?

michelle: I'm primary for deploy + rollout. jordan covers smoke. anya will own rollback actions. I'll kick off canary at 11:30.

jordan: On smoke -- I'll run health checks and a few inference e2e prompts, watch p99. Will post results here.

anya: I have the rollback runbook copied to /runbooks/deploy-rollback.md and local checklist ready. If we need to revert I'll run `./rollback.sh --tag v1.14.0` and follow the steps.

dev-db: migration-bot: migration v12->v13 scheduled at 11:31 (has down script) — reversible: yes.

sam: michelle can you confirm the feature flag kill switch and where to flip it quickly?

michelle: Flag is `feature.new_routing` in LaunchDarkly. Quick API toggle (internal): `curl -X POST https://console/internal/api/flags/feature.new_routing/off -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'`. I'll keep token in the ops vault.

jordan: My smoke checklist (short):
- `GET /health` -> 200
- sample call to `/v1/infer` (short prompt) -> latency <200ms and coherent output
- check logs for errors / rate-limit spikes
- check token billing dashboard for abnormal token counts

anya: Rollback checklist (high level):
1) Disable `feature.new_routing`
2) Promote previous service image `v1.13.9` to prod
3) Revert DB migration if needed (`migrate down v12`) — coordinate with @luis-oncall
4) Clear relevant cache keys (prod redis namespace)
5) Run sanity queries and smoke again

michelle: I'll hold the deploy button until we confirm DB reversible and oncall is present. :thumbsup:

sam: timing plan: cut canary at 11:30 PT -> 8 minute canary window -> final promote at ~11:38 if green. If smoke fails, target rollback start within 10 minutes.

deploy-bot: Automated canary started at 11:30 (release/v1.14.0) — will auto-promote after 8m unless aborted.

anya: I'll be watching logs + metrics. If I see error rate >1% or inference p99 >400ms I'll call rollback.

luis-oncall: here and available until 13:00 PT. I'll help with DB revert or migration down if needed. Ping me @luis-oncall before executing.

michelle: pushing canary in 2 minutes. keeping postmortem note template ready.

sam: final: go for 11:30. michelle start canary. I'll check back at 11:39 for go/no-go and will call rollback if any blocker.

jordan: ack — will post smoke summary in this thread when complete.

(End of thread)
